description.value: Starting at 6th level, a gunner can react to danger before his senses would normally allow him to do so. He cannot be caught flat-footed, nor does he lose his Dexterity bonus to AC if the attacker is invisible. He still loses his Dexterity bonus to AC if immobilized. A gunner with this ability can still lose his Dexterity bonus to AC if an opponent successfully uses the feint action against him. If a gunner already has uncanny dodge from a different class, he automatically gains improved uncanny dodge instead.
